roi_policy: Fixed from P03 original alone before inspecting any candidate. Pillow exclusive right/bottom. Covers forehead, eyes, both cheeks, nose, mouth and chin; identical coordinates across both runs and every step.
image_processing: Decode Pillow RGB, crop only. No resizing, registration, adaptive alignment, color correction, or normalization beyond stated metric ranges.
mae: Mean absolute error over RGB channels and pixels, float32 RGB [0,1]; also reported in [0,255] units.
limits: Fixed thresholds are transferred unchanged; no fitting or ratings used.
Descriptive image differences are not a validated detector or identity/surgery measure.
Fixed crops conflate pose, texture, lighting, and displacement with edited facial content.
Two sequential runs share one reference identity and do not establish generalization.
